basics.name: Justin Reeves
basics.label: Deployment systems engineer, automation builder, and customer-facing technical partner
basics.summary: I operate at the intersection of customer needs and engineering, building systems that reduce friction, improve adoption, and translate real-world deployment challenges into practical workflows. I care about shipping useful tools, not just interesting ideas.

work.name: Apple Inc.
work.summary: Centralized workflow platforms, AI-powered customer intelligence, and automation across teams.
highlights: Designed and built Cornerstone, a centralized workflow platform integrating Calendly, internal systems, and communication tools into a single system for managing customer engagements.
Leading development of an AI-powered customer intelligence system that aggregates engagement data, enables chat-based querying, and automates follow-ups using meeting transcripts.
Supported customers across K-12, higher education, and state/local government, guiding large-scale Apple deployments and best practices.
Built automation tools with Python, APIs, and Shortcuts that were adopted across multiple teams to reduce manual workflow overhead.

work.name: Apple Inc.
work.summary: Customer-facing technical support for school districts across Georgia.
highlights: Supported school districts across Georgia as a trusted technical advisor for Apple deployments.
Partnered with sales teams to remove technical blockers and support customer acquisition strategies.
Delivered technical workshops and deep dives on MDM, macOS deployment, and Apple School Manager.
Built automation tools to improve internal workflows and customer engagement processes.

work.name: Manhattan Associates
work.summary: Systems and onboarding improvements for Apple environments.
highlights: Rebuilt the macOS enrollment experience using Octory, improving transparency and user experience during device setup.
Designed a zero-touch deployment workflow integrating Jamf, Okta, and onboarding tools.
Trained and mentored engineers on Apple device management and Jamf best practices.
Provided high-touch support for executives and critical systems.

work.name: Equifax (Tata Consultancy Services)
highlights: Built global Jamf Pro Cloud deployment architecture, migrating from on-prem infrastructure to a more scalable model.
Designed standardized enrollment workflows and configuration profiles for global device management.
Implemented Apple content caching strategy across regions to improve performance and reduce bandwidth usage.
Developed a Python-based macOS LAPS solution for secure admin credential management.

work.summary: End-to-end Apple device management and district operations.
highlights: Owned end-to-end Apple device management strategy for the district.
Built automation workflows using scripting and APIs to improve IT efficiency.
Developed internal tools and dashboards to support deployment and operations.
Managed vendor relationships, inventory, and lifecycle processes.
